name: Thermal / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A charred limb separates with a dry fibrous tearing crack, one tight flame whip and a quick gritty ember shower. A very short physical break with fire at the cut.
